messages:
kevin: quick provocation 11111111111111Hey team: what if the rollout console had a "surge explainability" panel that shows why fallbacks trended up during spikes (not just that they happened) — want quick takes.
sana: yes please. ops currently sees counts but not the signal mix. a stacked timeline that breaks down triggers (latency vs error vs quota) would help.
charlie: also surface policy provenance: which rule evaluated first, whether route override shadowed global, and exact policy hash. crucial for postmortems.
kevin: exactly. idea: timeline rows = triggers, with hover that surfaces one-line audit cards linking to trace. allow "jump to trace" or "replay request" (redacted).
ops-bot: note: replay must check redaction and escalate if plaintext prompts requested. include audit entry on replay.
ux-bot: UX thought: add a small inline diff view when toggling policies so you can see "what changed" (e.g. threshold 0.75 -> 0.6) and expected delta. tiny graph snippet next to diff.
milo: telemetry ask: simulation should return both deterministic matches and probabilistic draws. i.e. for stochastic rules give sample_count and expected_mean/stddev.
sana: simulation mode should support "spike injection" toggle: apply an artificial N req/sec burst so PMs can see fragility. helpful for capacity planning.
charlie: API question: do we extend /policies/simulate or add /rollouts/explain? prefer adding an explain endpoint that composes sim + audit view so frontend gets UI-shaped data.
kevin: sample response sketch:
```
{
  "explain_id":"exp-20260315-ff12",
  "timeline": [{"ts":"...","trigger":"latency_ms>1200","count":123}],
  "policy_diff":"threshold 0.75 -> 0.6",
  "samples":["trace:aa1","trace:bb2"]
}
```
charlie: agree. make explain endpoint async with lightweight preview. front-end can poll /explain/{id}/results.
ux-bot: small accessibility note: timeline should be colorblind-safe and keyboard-navigable. include textual summary for screen readers.
kevin: next steps: i'll mock the panel and the tiny audit card, milo can draft the endpoint shape and fields, sana will write the spike-in options and redaction policy. meet tomorrow 11am to sync.
